analysis.headline: Energy and Consumer Staples Lead Equity Rotations While Technology Deteriorates
analysis.market_regime: Defensive and value-oriented leadership with tech softening
analysis.executive_summary: Quantitative evidence reflects strong relative leadership shifting toward Energy (XLE) and Consumer Staples (KXI, XLP), alongside value style outperformance (IWD vs IWF) and sustained strength in Latin American equities (EWZ, ILF). Conversely, broad Information Technology (XLK), Semiconductors (SMH), and Nasdaq-100 (QQQ) exhibit significant weakening, while Mortgage Real Estate (REM) remains severely depressed.

cross_market_confirmations: Energy leadership is confirmed across domestic and global structures: U.S. Energy (XLE) holds a confirmed ACCELERATING state (score 97.27) while Global Energy (IXC) holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state (score 76.00).

Consumer Staples improvement is confirmed across structures: Global Consumer Staples (KXI) and U.S. Consumer Staples (XLP) both hold confirmed EMERGING states with scores of 90.83 and 84.09, respectively.

Technology weakness is confirmed across domestic and thematic groups: U.S. IT (XLK, score 41.36), Semiconductors (SMH, score 31.67), and Nasdaq-100 (QQQ, score 56.67) all share confirmed WEAKENING states.
risks_or_conflicts: Health Care sector divergence: Medical Devices (IHI, 20-bar score change +40.00) exhibits strengthening relative momentum, whereas Biotechnology (XBI, 20-bar score change -24.63) and Pharmaceuticals (XPH, score 26.11) reflect marked internal sector weakness.

Financials sector divergence: Insurance (KIE, 20-bar score change +22.87) exhibits relative score gains, contrasting sharply with Regional Banks (KRE, 20-bar score change -32.22) and broad Banks (KBE, score 23.52) which demonstrate significant deterioration.

Materials sector divergence: Broad Materials (XLB, 20-bar score change +22.27) shows recent score improvement, while Metals & Mining (XME, 20-bar score change -19.44) deteriorates into near-bottom scores.
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
